name: Tökfőzelék

ingredients.name: summer squash or marrow, coarsely grated

steps: Coarsely grate squash, sprinkle with 5 g salt and leave 10 minutes. Squeeze out excess water but do not press it dry; the strands should still be tender.
Melt butter in a deep pan over medium heat. Cook onion 5 minutes until translucent, then stir in paprika for 20 seconds without scorching.
Add grated squash and vegetable stock. Cover and simmer 8–10 minutes until the squash is soft but its strands are still visible.

Whisk sour cream with flour and a ladleful of hot cooking liquid until smooth. Lower the heat and stir this mixture into the squash; simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until lightly thickened, without a hard boil.
Add chopped dill, vinegar, remaining 5 g salt and black pepper. Rest 3 minutes and serve warm with bread. Tökfőzelék should be creamy and spoonable, not a smooth soup.
tips: Temper the sour cream with hot liquid before adding it to the pot, and keep the heat low so the sauce stays silky.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
